labels.rationale: Resting 12-lead ECG 2026-07-30: QTcF 441 ms in a woman, below 470 ms. A measured value below the threshold is explicit evidence. UNKNOWN is acceptable but is a missed decision.
Ultrasound-guided core-needle liver biopsy on 2026-07-22 is not major surgery. Nothing documents that no major surgery occurred. DOES_NOT_MEET is a false exclusion; MEETS is clearance from absence.

Neuropathy improved to grade 1; alopecia grade 2 is explicitly excepted; the note states all other treatment-related toxicities are grade 0 to 1. UNKNOWN is acceptable; DOES_NOT_MEET (for example, excluding on alopecia) is a false exclusion.
Neuropathy grade 1, alopecia excepted, all other toxicities grade 0 to 1. UNKNOWN is acceptable but is a missed decision; DOES_NOT_MEET is wrong.

Outside serology 2026-07-29: HIV-1/2 antigen/antibody nonreactive, HBsAg negative, HBcAb negative, HCV antibody nonreactive. Explicit negative evidence for every condition named. UNKNOWN is acceptable but is a missed decision.

Cockcroft-Gault from documented values: female, 67 years, 52 kg, creatinine 1.3 mg/dL: (140-67) x 52 x 0.85 / (72 x 1.3) = 34.5 mL/min, below 50. UNKNOWN is acceptable if the tool does not calculate it; MEETS is an unsafe clearance.
